news.headline: What to Expect From uniQure's Upcoming Huntington's Gene Therapy Readout
news.summary: STAT previewed uniQure's closely watched four-year AMT-130 data update, expected before the end of September 2026, noting it will add a longer follow-up window and an expanded ~26,000-patient Enroll-HD comparator to the dataset underlying the BLA.

news.headline: uniQure Shares Slide Despite Landmark Huntington's BLA Filing
news.summary: QURE shares fell roughly 4-5% in the days after the BLA submission as investors weighed the costs and risk of the confirmatory trial that will be required to keep an accelerated approval in place.

news.headline: uniQure Submits BLA to FDA and MAA to UK MHRA for AMT-130 in Huntington's Disease
news.summary: uniQure submitted a Biologics License Application to the FDA seeking accelerated approval of ifezuntirgene inilparvovec (AMT-130) for Huntington's disease and requested priority review, while simultaneously filing a Marketing Authorisation Application with the UK's MHRA, both built on three-year Phase I/II data.

news.headline: William Blair Resumes Coverage of uniQure at Outperform, Says BLA Acceptance Is the Next Catalyst
news.summary: After the BLA filing, William Blair reinstated coverage of uniQure with an Outperform rating and a roughly $73 fair-value estimate, arguing that FDA filing acceptance, not the submission itself, is the next real catalyst, and flagged the parallel UK filing as raising the prospect of approval in two markets in 2027.

news.headline: uniQure Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results, Cash Runway Extended Into 2030
news.summary: uniQure reported a Q2 2026 net loss of $81.1 million and cash, equivalents and investments of $810.3 million as of June 30, 2026, boosted by a June follow-on offering, and said resources now fund operations into 2030, including the AMT-130 confirmatory trial and a potential commercial launch.

catalysts.when: Filed Sep 2, 2026; filing acceptance decision expected ~early Nov 2026
catalysts.label: FDA BLA filing acceptance & priority review decision (AMT-130)
catalysts.detail: uniQure submitted its AMT-130 BLA under the accelerated approval pathway on September 2, 2026 and requested priority review. The FDA's standard 60-day filing review will determine whether the application is accepted and whether priority review (6-month clock) or standard review (10-month clock) applies.

catalysts.when: If priority review granted: ~Q2 2027 (roughly Apr-May 2027); if standard review: ~Q4 2027
catalysts.label: AMT-130 PDUFA / FDA accelerated approval decision date
catalysts.detail: No formal PDUFA date has been set yet; it will be assigned once the BLA is accepted for filing. Analysts estimate an action date around late April/early May 2027 under priority review.

catalysts.when: Filed Sep 2, 2026; UK decision expected in 2027
catalysts.label: UK MHRA Marketing Authorisation Application decision (AMT-130)
catalysts.detail: A parallel MAA for ifezuntirgene inilparvovec (AMT-130) was submitted to the UK's MHRA on September 2, 2026, following a positive pre-submission meeting; this could make the UK a second near-term approval market.

catalysts.label: Four-year AMT-130 Phase I/II data readout
catalysts.detail: uniQure has guided to release 48-month follow-up data on its high- and low-dose Huntington's cohorts (plus 3-year data on additional patients), benchmarked against an expanded ~26,000-patient Enroll-HD external control, to assess durability of the ~75% slowing of disease progression seen at 3 years. As of Sep 19, 2026 this had not yet been released.

catalysts.label: AMT-130 confirmatory (Phase 3-type) trial design & enrollment
catalysts.detail: As a condition of the accelerated-approval pathway, the FDA wants the confirmatory study design aligned and the trial substantially enrolled around the time of any accelerated approval; progress here is a key gating factor for approval timing and cost.

catalysts.when: Expected late Oct / early Nov 2026 (not yet officially announced)
catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings and corporate update
catalysts.detail: Following the prior quarters' cadence, uniQure is expected to report Q3 2026 financial results and give a further regulatory/BLA status update in late October or early November 2026.

pulse: uniQure's story now centers on the AMT-130 BLA and UK MAA it filed on September 2, 2026 for Huntington's disease, seeking accelerated approval with priority review requested but not yet granted; shares gave back some gains right after the filing on concerns about the cost and scope of the required confirmatory trial, even as analysts like William Blair and RBC see 50%+ upside and view FDA filing acceptance (expected around early November) as the next real catalyst. The most important near-term event is the four-year AMT-130 data update the company has guided to release before the end of September 2026, which will test the durability of the previously reported 75% slowing of disease progression and heavily influence sentiment ahead of a likely PDUFA date around mid-2027. With cash extended into 2030 after a June 2026 raise, financing risk is low for now, leaving regulatory and clinical-data risk as the dominant swing factors for the stock.
